item: Latest's content-type and tag options and the source-type facets count per source from indexes alone
summary: Both joins were served by reading every article row (text included; quarantined and created_at sit after content), which on the field stores ran past the 60 s statement deadline after each unlock until the rollups were rebuilt. Per-source counts now come from idx_article_feed_scan (all time, quarantined left out) or from idx_article_created_at joined to idx_article_source_id by rowid (a created_at window), forced with INDEXED BY because the planner without statistics took idx_article_source_id and read the row; then folded onto the sources table in Python with the old semantics (COALESCE keeps '', NULL tags offer none, an orphan source_id is dropped). Measured on a 150,000-article 1.03 GB plaintext store, rchar: source-types 2,628 MB / 527 ms -> 2.5 MB / 21 ms; latest 1,576 MB / 1,069 ms -> 12.6 MB / 579 ms. A store missing an index ('no such index') falls back to the old plan with the same counts; any other error (a deadline) is raised and not retried.
